title: Frontend: Configure Vite proxy, React Router, Zustand, TanStack Query
description: Set up the frontend project with all required routing, state management, and data fetching infrastructure. Configure Vite dev server to proxy API calls to the Express backend.
acceptanceCriteria: React Router v6 configured with all route definitions
Zustand store for auth state (user, accessToken)
TanStack Query configured with default stale time and retry settings
All packages installed: react-router-dom, zustand, @tanstack/react-query, axios

steps.details: In root (frontend): npm install react-router-dom zustand @tanstack/react-query @tanstack/react-query-devtools axios date-fns framer-motion. npm install -D @types/node.
In vite.config.ts, add server.proxy: { '/api': { target: 'http://localhost:3000', changeOrigin: true } }. This lets the frontend call /api/* without CORS issues in development.

steps.description: Set up React Router in main.tsx
steps.details: Wrap App with BrowserRouter. Create src/routes/index.tsx with route definitions: '/' → LandingPage, '/login' → LoginPage, '/register' → RegisterPage, '/dashboard' → Dashboard (protected), '/projects/:id' → ProjectDetail (protected), '/share/:token' → PublicSharePage, '/settings' → Settings (protected).

Create src/stores/authStore.ts. Store: { user: User | null, accessToken: string | null, setAuth(user, token), clearAuth() }. Access token stored in memory only (not localStorage — use HttpOnly cookie for refresh token).
Create src/lib/queryClient.ts: new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { staleTime: 30_000, retry: 1 } } }). Wrap App with QueryClientProvider in main.tsx.

Create src/lib/api.ts. Create axios instance with baseURL: '/api'. Add request interceptor to inject Authorization: Bearer TOKEN from authStore. Add response interceptor to handle 401 responses: call /api/auth/refresh, update token in store, retry original request.
Start both server (npm run dev in server/) and frontend (npm run dev in root). Open http://localhost:5173. Verify no console errors. Make a test API call to /api/health — verify it proxies correctly.
